entities.summary: Downtown Records is an American record label based in New York City with offices in Los Angeles. Owned and operated by Josh Deutsch and Terence Lam, the label is distributed by Interscope Capitol Labels Group in the US, in the UK distributed by Polydor Records, and in the EU distributed by The Orchard.
